content: This space answers questions about store sales. The data is the governed Metric View workspace.gold.store_sales_metrics, which reads the gold fct_store_sales fact joined to the customer, store, item, promotion, and date dimensions on their surrogate keys. Query measures with MEASURE(`<measure>`) and group by the dimension names; answers match the dashboards because every number comes from this one governed definition.

Measures, with their governed names: Sales Quantity means SUM(quantity). Gross Sales means SUM(sales_price * quantity). Net Paid means SUM(net_paid). Net Profit means SUM(net_profit). Wholesale Cost means SUM(wholesale_cost). List Price means SUM(list_price). Extended Discount Amount means SUM(discount_amount). Extended Sales Price means SUM(sales_amount), the extended sales price of the line and the measure to use for net revenue; never use sales_price alone for revenue.

Dimensions, with their governed names: Store ID, Store Name, Item ID, Brand, Category, Customer ID, Promotion Name, Sold Date, Ticket Number. Slice sales by any of these. Sold Date is the day of the sale.
A Ticket Number groups the lines of one store visit. A line may carry no promotion.
